import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
lane=Path.cwd(); writer=str(lane/'write_lane.py')
proof='''# Independent reconstruction before author read
For k>=4, lambda>0, 0<=theta<1, write x=u^k,y=v^k,a=lambda^(1/k). The positive kth root gives (4.9) reversibly. The diagonal equation x=lambda*((1+(1+theta)x)/(1+2x))^k has strictly decreasing RHS for theta<1; its difference from x changes sign between zero and infinity, so exactly one root.
For an off-diagonal root swap to u>v and put t=u/v>1. Dividing the equations yields 1=v^k D(t)/(t-1), D=t^k-t-theta*(t^(k+1)-1). Thus v^k=(t-1)/D and a=v*(t^(k+1)-1)/(t^k-1). Conversely these positive quantities satisfy the ratio equation and the difference equation, hence both original equations. All denominators are positive precisely when D>0; no loss from divisions since t>1,theta<1,v>0.
Put t=exp(2s),s>0. Then lambda=L(s)= sinh(s)/(sinh((k-1)s)-theta*sinh((k+1)s)) * (sinh((k+1)s)/sinh(ks))^k. R(s)=sinh((k-1)s)/sinh((k+1)s) decreases strictly from (k-1)/(k+1) to zero: its logarithmic derivative is f(k-1)-f(k+1)<0, f(b)=b*coth(bs). Hence domain empty at theta>=theta_c; for theta=0 domain all positive s; otherwise domain (0,s_theta),R(s_theta)=theta.
For fixed s>0, f'(b)=coth(bs)-bs*csch(bs)^2>0 (sinh(z)cosh(z)>z); f''(b)=2s*csch(bs)^2*(bs*coth(bs)-1)>0 (z cosh(z)>sinh(z)). Therefore each increment f(j+1)-f(j), j=1,...,k-2, is strictly smaller than Delta=f(k+1)-f(k)>0. The log derivative of L_0 is f(1)-f(k-1)+k*Delta>2*Delta>0. L=L_0/(1-theta/R), whose second factor is positive nondecreasing (strict for theta>0). Thus L strictly increases.
Its lower endpoint is lambda_c=((k+1)/k)^k/[k-1-(k+1)theta]. For theta>0 the upper endpoint diverges as R decreases to theta. For theta=0, sinh asymptotics give L_0~exp(2s), hence infinity. Exactly one s exists iff lambda>lambda_c. Equality gives no off-diagonal root; s=0 is diagonal and cannot be counted again. Each s yields one ordered u>v and its distinct swap. Consequently one positive root pair below/equal critical, exactly three above; theta>=theta_c gives only diagonal.
Gibbs bridge to audit against actual glyphs: with z=(1,x,y), Q_{ij}=theta for opposite nonzero signs and 1 otherwise, P_{ij}=Q_{ij}z_j/sum_l Q_{il}z_l. Row zero determines x,y from ratios P_0,+/P_0,0 and P_0,-/P_0,0. Positive z yields compatible tree Markov measures; hard-core zeros do not affect row-zero positivity. Full DLR/converse and root convention require source audit before PASS.
'''
subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',writer,'PROOF.md'],input=proof,text=True,check=True)
for p in [3,4,5,9,12,13,14,15]:
 subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(p),'-l',str(p),'-scale-to','1600','-png','inputs/wr.pdf',str(lane/f'wr-view-{p}')],check=True)
print('RECONSTRUCTION SAVED; RENDERS COMPLETE')
